p.me: \begin{aligned} \int 60 \cos^4(15 x)dx \amp = 60 \int \left( \cos^2(15 x) \right)^2 dx \\\\ \amp = 60 \int \left( \frac 1 2 (1 + \cos(30 x)) \right)^2 dx \\\\ \amp = 15 \left( \int dx + 2 \int \cos(30 x) dx + \int \cos^2(30 x) dx \right) \\\\ \amp = 15 \left( x + \frac{1}{15} \sin(30 x) + \int \frac 1 2 \left(1 + \cos(60 x)\right) dx \right) \\\\ \amp = 15 \left( x + \frac{1}{15} \sin(30 x) + \frac 1 2 \int dx + \frac 1 2 \int \cos(60 x)dx \right) \\\\ \amp = 15 \left( x + \frac{1}{15} \sin(30 x) + \frac x 2 + \frac{1}{120} \sin(60 x) \right) \\\\ \amp = 22.5 x + \sin(30 x) + \frac{15}{120} \sin(60 x) \end{aligned}
